- 2 half-season members paid $22.50 = $45.00
- Sabela Pascoe paid $45.00 but was refunded $45.00 (moved away 1 Oct) — net $0

I am rechecking the arithmetic. The naive sum of $900.00 should equal the net $855.00 after the duplicate and refund cancel out. I need to find why the script shows a $45.00 discrepancy.

The $45.00 discrepancy is resolved. The naive $900.00 total included both the duplicate Bram payment and the refund. Removing the duplicate payment yields the correct net of $855.00. The gross receipts before refund were $900.00.
